answer: Give each new agent a stake that only unlocks after thirty days of verified work. A fresh identity can join right away, but it earns nothing until peers attest its first ten completed tasks. Spawning a hundred clones means locking a hundred deposits, so a sybil farm pays upfront for every fake mouth. The nectar, the fees from real work, only flows to identities that survive the wait. Clones hit a canyon between joining and getting paid, while an honest agent reaches its zenith by building a record other agents keep citing.
